media.title: Sam Wood directing Beyond the Rocks, 1922
media.altText: Black-and-white photograph of the director Sam Wood at work on a film set in 1922.
media.publicCaption: Sam Wood directing Beyond the Rocks (Famous Players-Lasky, 1922) — thirteen years before the work documented here. Wood directed A Night at the Opera (1935) and A Day at the Races (1937), both carrying songs by Kaper and Jurmann.
